title: Hamabe no Uta
attribution: "Song of the Seashore": music by Tamezō Narita (died 1945), composed by 1916 to a poem by Kokei Hayashi (died 1947) first printed in 1913, published by Senō Gakufu in 1918. Public domain: published before 1931 (United States) and all authors died before 1972 (Canada). Verses 1 and 2 (the third verse, which Hayashi disowned, is left out), in the original key of A flat.
